metadata.note: PLAN v3 Task 9 scenario B (controller ruling): the migration path the author's three real machines take today — `config-saver` built from Git via `package_sources` (pkgbuild-git, pinned SHA), no `[amt911]` repo declared at all. The guest driver (guest-pacman-repo-migrate.sh) then `plan`s config/vm-pacman-repo.json (the repo config, WITHOUT package_sources) against this already-installed machine and asserts the switch only ever ADDS the key+repo — it must never touch [packages] (config-saver is already installed; the repo just becomes its new provider). NOT for real hardware. Needs NETWORK: git clone of config-saver-aur.git during install, then (in the guest driver) the real https://amt911.github.io/arch-packages/$arch sync. Autologins root on ttyS0 and ships python-pydantic/python-colorama so dasik runs from the 9p-mounted repo for the guest driver.
metadata.disk: 12G: config-saver's build (base-devel + its own dependency tree) needs more room than the 8G minimal configs.
